goals.description: Provide office visitors with a way to check office opening hours.

responsibilities.description: Read office opening hours on the public web page.
Implement every product requirement and implementation task.
Provide the hosting environment and the domain name.

requirements.description: The page must display the fixed text "Monday to Friday, 09:00-17:00" to every visitor.
Visitors must be able to read the opening hours without signing in.
The application shall not contain editing, booking, accounts or other features.
The page must use the existing company hosting environment and the existing company domain.

resolutions.description: The Full-stack Developer is responsible and accountable for the hosting and domain, utilizing existing company assets.

S1.quote: Build a small public web page so office visitors can check the office opening hours.

S2.quote: The page must display the fixed text "Monday to Friday, 09:00-17:00" to every visitor.

S3.quote: Visitors must be able to read the opening hours without signing in.

S4.quote: This version contains only this static information page; it has no editing, booking, accounts or other product features.

S5.quote: The project has one team member, a Full-stack Developer.

S6.quote: The Full-stack Developer is both Responsible and Accountable for implementing every product requirement and every implementation task.

S7.quote: The Full-stack Developer is both Responsible and Accountable for testing every product requirement.

S8.quote: The Full-stack Developer is both Responsible and Accountable for deploying the page.

S9.quote: There are no separate business-requirements approval, specification preparation, specification acceptance, user acceptance testing or release-decision activities in this small demo project.

S10.quote: The Full-stack Developer is both Responsible and Accountable for providing the hosting environment and the domain name.

S11.quote: The page will use the existing company hosting environment and the existing company domain; no purchase or new infrastructure is in scope.
